newsitem.title: THAILAND: Procter Gamble Thai details business plan.
newsitem.headline: Procter Gamble Thai details business plan.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said on Thursday it plans to invest an additional 700 million baht ($26.9 million) in Thailand over the next 12 months.

Wilfried Van Assche, managing director of Procter & Gamble Manufacturing (Thailand) Ltd, told a news conference that his firm's investment would double its production of diapers, skincare and haircare products.
Van Assche said P&G, celebrating the 10th anniversary of its Thai operation this month, has invested over 2.2 billion baht with the figure expected to rise to five billion baht by the year 2000.
He said the wholly-owned P&G unit also plans to double its exports to over 10 countries in the next 12 months.

"Thailand is now a major exporter in this capital-intensive industry. Thailand is exporting haircare products to highly quality-conscious markets such as Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Malaysia and Indonesia," he said.
P&G's Thai sale revenue during the year ending June 30 rose 14 percent from a year ago to 5.7 billion baht.
